svg.title: Plate PL-07 — The bat: active inference you can measure
svg.desc: An engraved-style encyclopedia plate on bat echolocation, drawn from chapter CN-10. Panel I draws the sonar loop as one turn of a cycle: emit, echo returned after 2R over c, belief update, call adaptation. The arrow from echo to belief update is marked with a double arrow and annotated as the epistemic term, with the type distinction printed: the arrow carries the realized Kullback-Leibler update in nats after the echo arrives, while the epistemic term of expected free energy is that update's expectation under q of o given pi, taken at the emit node before emitting. Panel II draws range as delay, 2R equals ct, at 5.83 milliseconds per metre on a logarithmic range ruler. Panel III draws the call-duration collapse across search, approach and terminal buzz, 15 to 20 milliseconds down to 0.5 to 1 millisecond, with the overlap-free floor R at least c tau over 2 collapsing with it. Panel IV draws the terminal buzz rate rise to beyond 160 calls per second and records as a refuted negative the tidy pulse-echo-overlap explanation that predicts 1.07 metres; laryngeal motor performance binds first. Panel V draws Doppler-shift compensation to scale on a frequency axis: an 83.0 kilohertz emission returns at 85.4 kilohertz when closing at 5 metres per second, roughly 1 kilohertz clear of the auditory fovea's 84.5 kilohertz upper edge, and the bat lowers its emission by about 2.4 kilohertz to 80.6 kilohertz to land the echo back on the reference frequency; this is annotated as an ambiguity-minimising action, not the epistemic term and not policy precision gamma. Panel VI draws the price of the epistemic term as a knee at about 130 decibels sound pressure level at 0.1 metre, with no y axis, because the corpus carries no cost value. Panel VII carries the figure key, a numbered caption, and what the plate does not claim. Every number carries units, a ledger row and an evidence class. Zero UNI claims.
svg.text: THE BAT — ACTIVE INFERENCE YOU CAN MEASURE
Source chapter: CN-10 (cookbook/recipes-natura/CN-10-bats.md) · rows CN10-01…CN10-53 of encyclopedia/NATURE-LEDGER.md · G(π) decomposition from NA-02 · corpus tip f1be794
ZERO UNI CLAIMS ON THIS PLATE
A nature citation is never a UNI gate.

THE DECOMPOSITION — NA-02 · △ MODELED; the assumption is the convention q(o,s|π) = p(o|s) q(s|π)
Both lines are the SAME G(π),
TWO DECOMPOSITIONS OF ONE NUMBER — and the terms DO NOT map one-to-one: ambiguity ≠ −epistemic, risk ≠ −pragmatic.
The ⟹ arrow is the EPISTEMIC term. Panel V's Doppler-shift compensation lowers the AMBIGUITY term — a different term of the
same G(π). Reading either as the other, or either as precision γ, is the error CN-10 was written to refuse. See Panel VII. · π = a policy, not the circle constant.
The echo carries range as DELAY. Drawn on a LOG ruler, so the
~40-fold span from the buzz floor (R_min = 0.086 m) to the search
ceiling (R_min = 3.4 m) fits one axis. △ computed here from CN10-18.
On a log ruler the DELAY scale
is why the ticks above need no
Change c by 5% and EVERY metre
on this plate moves by 5%. The
reference for c in air. CN10-01
on this ruler, and none is implied
THE COLLAPSE — call duration is an action, and it falls ~30× across one attack
A call of duration τ is not a point in time — it is c·τ METRES OF AIR. The echo from range R starts arriving 2R/c after the call STARTS; the call is still sounding until τ.
Overlap-free ranging therefore requires 2R/c ≥ τ, i.e. R ≥ c·τ/2. △ CN10-18 — derived in-chapter from τ (CN10-15/16/17) and c (CN10-01). Read the floor against the phase:
□ c·τ — the call's own length in air
1.07 m — the REFUTED buzz ceiling, Panel IV ✗
READ THE FLOOR AGAINST THE PHASE. The bat's call duration collapses by a factor of ~30 across the attack, and the overlap-free floor collapses with it — staying just under the
closing target. A search call could not cleanly range anything nearer than 2.6–3.4 m, and would be blind at the moment of capture. The bat does not solve this with better
processing. IT CHANGES ITS OWN EMISSION SO THE QUESTION STAYS ANSWERABLE. That is action taken to keep an inference well-posed, and it is measured in milliseconds.
On a log ruler R_min = c·τ/2 is the c·τ bar shifted left by log₁₀ 2 — the same shift for every phase. △ computed on this plate.
THE TERMINAL BUZZ — and the refutation of its obvious explanation
Closing on prey, a bat drives its call rate to the ceiling: the measurable signature of an
agent throwing its information rate to the maximum at exactly the moment uncertainty is
most expensive. The epistemic term is being maximised where the pragmatic term is about
to be settled. Then: what sets the ceiling?
‡ FENCE THE SPLICE. The two bars are DIFFERENT SPECIES and different studies. The corpus carries
exactly TWO rates — no per-phase ladder exists here. Two levels are drawn, NOT a curve through them.
✗ RECORDED NEGATIVE — “pulse–echo overlap sets the buzz ceiling.”
At PI = 1/160 s = 6.25 ms the unambiguous range is c·PI/2 = 343 × 0.00625 / 2 = 1.07 m △ CN10-22 — a tidy story in
which the bat stops speeding up because it would start confusing echoes. Arithmetically correct, widely repeatable,
and REFUTED: Elemans et al. 2011 measured the actuator and found a previously unknown class of superfast muscle.
LARYNGEAL MOTOR PERFORMANCE BINDS FIRST — CN10-21. The constraint is the meat, not the mathematics.
A clean, plausible, arithmetically correct hypothesis lost to a direct measurement. Record which one won.
✗ is CN-10's own inline defect log, NOT a NATURA evidence class — see the KEY, Panel VII.
DOPPLER-SHIFT COMPENSATION — action taken to hold the echo in the fovea
A horseshoe bat's cochlea has an AUDITORY FOVEA: a grossly expanded frequency representation centred on a narrow
REFERENCE FREQUENCY. The bat's model of the world is sharp inside a ~1.5 kHz slot and blunt outside it. Flying at the
target ruins this — the bat flies its own signal out of the only band where its likelihood p(o|s) is precise. Drawn to scale:
≈ 1 kHz clear of the 84.5 kHz UPPER EDGE
B · COMPENSATED — what the bat does
100 px per kHz — DRAWN TO SCALE
THE CONTROL PRECISION, ON THE SAME 100 px/kHz SCALE — this is why the brackets are hairlines and the fovea is a slab:
band_DSC = 0.1–0.2% of F_ref ≈ 83–166 Hz at F_ref = 83 kHz — CN10-26
rhinolophids and P. parnellii · the precision F_echo is held WITHIN
offset_DSC = ~150–200 Hz — F_ref held ABOVE F_rest — CN10-27
R. ferrumequinum, R. euryale, P. parnellii, in flight · the OFFSET, not the band
‡ THE SPLICE THIS AXIS EXPOSES — and why SD_echo is NOT drawn on it.
CN10-24 carries SD_echo = 110 Hz = 0.17% of F_ref — H. armiger, a HIPPOSIDERID, not a rhinolophid. But 110 Hz is 0.13% of 83 kHz
(△ computed on this plate). 0.17% ≠ 0.13%, so H. armiger's F_ref is NOT the 83 kHz drawn here, and the two must not be multiplied
together. ◇ NOT-SOURCED: F_ref for H. armiger. ○ NOT-MEASURED: fovea width and DSC precision in ONE animal — CN10-30. The
chapter's “~14× finer than the fovea is wide” is ILLUSTRATIVE ACROSS TWO SPECIES. Any ratio read off this axis inherits that fence.
IT IS NOT ADAPTING ITS MODEL TO ITS SENSATIONS. IT IS ADAPTING ITS SENSATIONS TO ITS MODEL.
The bat cannot move its fovea, so it moves the world's input into it, by changing its own motor output, in closed loop. TYPE IT: this is NOT γ. NA-02's γ is POLICY
precision (nats⁻¹, the softmax inverse temperature over policies). The fovea is SENSORY precision — the sharpness of p(o|s). An action moving the echo into the band
where p(o|s) is sharpest lowers the AMBIGUITY term E_q(s|π)[ H[ p(o|s) ] ] of G(π) directly. DSC is an AMBIGUITY-minimising action — not the ⟹ epistemic arrow.
WHAT THE EPISTEMIC TERM COSTS — a function with a knee, and the knee has been measured
For a method claiming agents trade energy for uncertainty reduction, the price of the call is the whole question. It was a live dispute, and it resolved ALONG AN AXIS — which is the best kind.
NEGLIGIBLE — the call rides an exhalation the flight muscles are producing anyway
SL_open ~130, up to and beyond 140 — CN10-33
○ the corpus carries no cost value in J, W
or ml O₂. CN10-41 carries a REGIME, not a
number. The knee's LOCATION is sourced;
the curve's SHAPE and HEIGHT are not,
and so they are not drawn.
p @ 140 dB = 20×10⁻⁶ × 10^(140/20) = 200 Pa at 0.1 m — about 0.2% of one atmosphere, from a mammal weighing a few grams. △ CN10-35
“No cost of echolocation for bats in flight”.
MECHANISM OFFERED: the call rides an exhalation
the flight muscles are producing anyway.
Re-tested in the 5 g Rhogeessa io: cost of transport
NOT related to pulse emission rate, and flight power
LOWER than predicted if call cost were additive.
Consistent with Speakman & Racey. Non-buzz rate
19.7 ± 2.7 pulses/s — CN10-42, drawn in Panel IV.
BOUNDED IT. Costs are negligible ONLY for low call
intensities; above 130 dB SPL (re 10 cm) sound
production becomes, in their word, exorbitant for
small bats. So “echolocation is free during flight” is
not wrong — it is SCOPE-LIMITED, and 2020 printed
the scope. ‡ CN10-41 · resolved along intensity.
“Echolocation is free for flying bats”, quoted without the 2020 bound, is a SCOPE ERROR, not a citation. ✗ CN-10's inline defect log.
KEY, CAPTION, AND WHAT THIS PLATE DOES NOT CLAIM
this plate must survive greyscale printing
the ②→③ arrow of Panel I. Heavy weight + this mark, never colour.
measured, and independently replicated across labs, datasets or taxa.
measured, but genuinely disputed — or a splice. Both positions carried.
derived from a model that fits data. THE ASSUMPTIONS ARE THE FENCE.
nobody has measured it. An absence IN THE LITERATURE.
a value this corpus could not trace. An absence IN OUR HOMEWORK.
the primary is NAMED, at one remove, and was not read in this pass.
a defect, carried first-class — never deleted, never mocked.
The six marks — ‡ △ ○ ◇ ⌀ are NATURA classes (six of NA-00’s twelve, amended 2026-07-15:
three groups — measured / derived / fenced). ⟹ is a DRAWING mark, not a class; ✗ is CN-10’s
own inline defect log — and NEGATIVE is a UNI LEDGER STATE, never borrowed into NATURA.
CAPTION — six numbered readings, keyed to the panels
A bat emits, waits 2R/c, updates, and changes the next call. The call costs joules and dB and returns an echo
that does not feed, warm or move the bat: EMISSION COST PAID FOR INFORMATION RETURN, BOTH SIDES ON A METER. The arrow marked ⟹ — echo to belief
update — is where the information arrives. The EPISTEMIC TERM of G(π) is that arrow’s EXPECTATION, taken at ① before emitting. The arrow is an
outcome; the term scores a policy. Two different objects. Do not merge them.
The echo carries range as delay: 2R = ct, at 5.83 ms per metre of range, drawn on a log ruler so a
~40-fold span of range fits one axis — buzz floor 0.086 m to search ceiling 3.4 m, CN10-18. △ computed here.
Call duration τ falls ~30× across one attack — 15–20 ms to 0.5–1 ms — and the overlap-free
floor R ≥ c·τ/2 collapses with it, staying under the closing target. The bat does not solve overlap with better processing. It changes its own
emission so the question stays answerable.
Rate rises beyond 160 calls/s — information rate thrown to the ceiling where uncertainty is most
expensive. The ceiling is LARYNGEAL MOTOR PERFORMANCE, not pulse–echo overlap: a tidy, arithmetically correct hypothesis (1.07 m) that lost to a
work-loop assay on a muscle. Recorded ✗, first-class.
Closing at 5 m/s, an 83.0 kHz emission returns at 85.4 kHz — 2.4 kHz above F_ref,
and roughly 1 kHz clear of the fovea’s 84.5 kHz upper edge. (Both numbers are correct and they are NOT the same number; the ~1 kHz is the one that
carries the argument.) The bat lowers its emission ~2.4 kHz to 80.6 kHz and lands the echo back on F_ref. This lowers the AMBIGUITY term of G(π).
It is not the epistemic term, and it is not γ.
Below ~130 dB SPL @ 0.1 m the epistemic term is nearly free — it rides an action the animal is
taking anyway. Above it, sound production is exorbitant for small bats. The price of information is not zero and not constant. It is a function with a
knee, and the knee has been measured. No cost value is plotted: the corpus carries none.
WHAT THIS PLATE DOES NOT CLAIM
The measurements are the asset and they stand alone. If the active-inference lens were withdrawn tomorrow, DSC would still hold the echo to its band.
that a bat computes expected free energy.
Nothing here shows a bat evaluating G(π) over a policy space, or anything
isomorphic to it. G(π) in nats has never been decoded from any taxon:
○ NOT-MEASURED, NA-02. “Minimising the ambiguity term” is OUR description of
its behaviour, in our vocabulary, for our purposes. THE BAT IS NOT DOING OUR
γ is the softmax inverse temperature over policies, units nats⁻¹. The fovea is
SENSORY precision — the sharpness of p(o|s). Different objects, different units.
DSC lowers the AMBIGUITY term. Conflating them is a category error.
that the active-inference reading is REQUIRED
to explain any measurement here. Classical sensorimotor control, signal-
detection theory and plain optimal-foraging accounts predict much of it. No
discriminating experiment is offered, and none is known to the corpus in this
pass. Until one exists, the lens earns nothing it has not paid for.
a within-animal pairing of fovea width and DSC precision.
○ NOT-MEASURED — CN10-30. R. ferrumequinum’s fovea against H. armiger’s
DSC is a splice across two species and two families; Panel V prints the
arithmetic that exposes it. The “~14×” is illustrative, not a measurement.
The corpus carries exactly two rates — 19.7 ± 2.7 pulses/s non-buzz (R. io,
Voigt & Lewanzik 2012) and >160 calls/s buzz (Elemans et al. 2011; Moss &
Surlykke 2010). Different species, different studies. Panel IV draws two
levels and refuses to draw a curve through them.
any cost of echolocation in J, W or ml O₂.
Panel VI has no y axis because the corpus has no value to put on one. The
knee’s LOCATION (~130 dB SPL @ 0.1 m) is sourced; the curve’s SHAPE and
HEIGHT are not, and are not drawn.
The “jitter” psychophysics is contested and ◇ NOT-SOURCED here — CN10-32.
that the terminal-buzz ceiling is set by pulse–echo overlap.
✗ Refuted — CN10-21. The 1.07 m is drawn in Panel IV precisely BECAUSE it is
wrong. A derivation that predicts the right number for the wrong reason is
exactly the failure this wing exists to catch, and recording it is the point.
that a bat is conscious, aware, or has experience.
Nagel’s question is a real philosophical question. It is not answered,
addressed, or bounded by any measurement on this plate, and it lives in a
different ledger. A PERMANENT OPEN QUESTION. “Full human” and “beyond human”
appear here as no target, milestone or deliverable.
that any citation on this plate raises any UNI rung.
A NATURE CITATION IS NEVER A UNI GATE. The NATURA classes and the UNI 4-value
fence (proven / designed / hypothesized / not-yet-built) describe different
kinds of claim and NEVER merge. ZERO UNI CLAIMS ON THIS PLATE. Program
position, unsoftened: ~2 of 11+ rungs earned; a developmental active-inference
SIMULATION; a toy world, never a person.
